mintAuthority.summary: STBT issuance and custom-proxy upgrades share an issuer control contract with zero current delay and unverified proposer thresholds.

controls.label: STBT issuer and owner controller
controls.evidence: Pinned block 26107703: issuer, owner, moderator and controller all return this contract; getMinDelay returns zero. STBTv2 issue checks the reserve-feed budget, but owner can replace issuer and mint logic via the custom proxy. Effective proposer/admin membership and backend custody thresholds remain unknown.
